note: Rustic Chequamegon-Nicolet National Forest campground (Medford-Park Falls district) on the 411-acre Mondeaux Flowage, with a campers-only boat landing. Premium P sites each have a small dock; the sites are wooded and set back from the shore. Coin showers and a concession stand are at the nearby Mondeaux picnic area. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov read. 27 sites (FS; rec.gov lists 26), no hookups, 5 vault toilets + hand pump, $15 S / $18 P confirmed, 15 reservable + 11 FCFS, 4-day cutoff, 14-night max, season May 1-Oct 15 unchanged (manual). WATERFRONT LEAD lakefront -> lakeview (P sites under continuous canopy, water seen through trees). Pin fine (~85 m from the site centroid).
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD lakefront -> lakeview: recreation.gov tags P001-P018 'Lakefront' and the FS says each P site has a small dock, but on Esri the whole point is unbroken canopy and the plotted P-site points sit about 15-50 m up from the shore (P003 45.32725,-90.44635 ~50 m; P004 45.32717,-90.44589 ~35 m; P012 45.32673,-90.44368 and P013 45.32651,-90.44341 ~15-20 m, all under trees). The rec.gov site photos show the pads in open-understory woods with the flowage glimpsed between trunks (P004, P011) and no open ground to the water; P003/P008/P013/P014 show only woods. Under continuous canopy / behind trees = a view, so lakeview (the P sites, sold by the night at $18; 10 of them reservable in summer, P017-P018 first-come). The dock is a walk down through the trees.

SITES: FS posts 27 sites; the recreation.gov catalog lists 26 (no P016). No campground-wide rig limit: rec.gov caps P003 at 15 ft and P004 at 30 ft; other sites list 36-90 ft site lengths with no vehicle limit, and FS says 'some are over 40' long'. max_rig_ft left unset (no stated campground maximum).
SEASON: stored manual 05-01..10-15 matches the FS page; not rewritten.
STATUS: FS page currently shows 'Site Closed ... the campground is closed for the season' - the ordinary end-of-season closing, not a status.
PHONE 715-748-4875 and websites (rec.gov + FS page) confirmed current.
